'''0.12a''' is a major update for [[Survarium]] that added the [[School]] [[Locations|location]], activated [[anomalies]] and introduced an updated user interface.

==Changelog==
* Character synchronization with servers overhauled
* Addition of new level "[[School]]"
* Introduction of new user interface
* Enabled [[anomalies]] in game. Now the "isolation" stat will be more beneficial
* Added animations for carrying, lifting and throwing key items
* Removed ability to shoot and sprint when carrying an objective
* Improved weapon firing animations
* Improved walking and running animations
* Changed jumping animation
* Improved visuals (particle effects) for gun shots
* Added falling damage from great heights

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed an error in sound parameters
* Fixed bug causing random delay before a jump starts
* Adding friends now requires the consent of the player
